note: Public material only. Each fact carries its source URL, read on 2026-11-01. Times are local Lisbon time (WET, UTC+0).

name.value: Web Summit 2026 (Lisbon); Web Summit's own conference code is lis26

opening_night.value: Monday 9 November 2026: 'Opening Night' on Centre Stage from 18:00 (the title is still listed as 'Coming soon...'), then Night Summit 20:00-23:00 in Pavilion 5 (FIL), with regional meet-and-greets

conference_days.value: Tuesday 10, Wednesday 11 and Thursday 12 November 2026. The published schedule runs from about 10:00 to about 17:40 local time (Lisbon is on WET, UTC+0, in November)

our_stand.value: RiskMandate exhibits on Thursday 12 November 2026, booth A1-30, in ALPHA 1, Pavilion 1. The exact booth location is shown at the venue. A venue map came with the email (download it to zoom in), and the map is in the Web Summit app from the week of 9 November. Source: Web Summit's Startup Success team, email to the RiskMandate team, received 5 November 2026 (not public; forwarded by Silvio)

exhibitor_rules.value: One medium-sized handheld box of promotional material per startup may be brought in on the exhibition day, following Web Summit's guidelines. Take everything away at the end of the day: items left in a booth are thrown away, and excessive material or waste can be fined. Large bags and suitcases are not allowed in; there is a bag drop at both main entrances. Bring your own power adapters (none are provided) and have your materials available offline. Source: Web Summit's Startup Success team, email to the RiskMandate team, received 5 November 2026 (not public; forwarded by Silvio)

startup_lounge.value: A Startup Lounge between Pavilion 2 and Pavilion 3, only for the startup's ticket holders and the investors and speakers they are meeting. Startup masterclasses need no registration: first come, first served, schedule in the app. Source: Web Summit's Startup Success team, email to the RiskMandate team, received 5 November 2026 (not public; forwarded by Silvio)

info_point.value: From Monday 9 November the Startup Success team has limited access to email. For help during the event: the Info Point in Pavilion 5, Tuesday 10 to Thursday 12 November, 08:00-17:00, and the startup volunteers on the exhibition floor. Every team member should read Web Summit's essentials pages (getting to the venue, registration, the schedule). Source: Web Summit's Startup Success team, email to the RiskMandate team, received 5 November 2026 (not public; forwarded by Silvio)

venue.value: MEO Arena and FIL, Rossio dos Olivais, 1990-231 Lisbon, Parque das Nações. The site's config still also gives the arena's old name, 'Altice Arena'

attendance_claimed_2026.value: 70,000+ attendees (Web Summit's meetups and creator-programme pages). Over 15,000 companies a year, 10,000 of them startups, and over 2,500 exhibiting (Web Summit's evergreen 'what to expect' and startup-journey copy). Paddy Cosgrave told Tek Notícias that exhibition space is sold out, with more than 3,000 companies and 30,000 m2 of temporary halls. These are claims, not audited figures

attendance_2025_reference.value: 2025 edition: 71,386 attendees from 157 countries, 1,857 investors from 86 countries, 2,725 startups from 108 countries, 869 speakers (Web Summit's own figures)

speakers.value: Third parties report 850+ speakers. Web Summit's speakers page shows a first wave weighted towards Chinese AI and robotics companies (AgiBot, Manus AI, Unitree, Galbot, Replit, ModelBest, Xiaomi, Pony.ai, MiniMax, Tencent)

tracks.value: 17 content tracks plus Centre Stage. The track pages are: AI Summit, Commerce Summit, Corporate Innovation Summit, Creative Summit, Cybersecurity Summit, Developer Summit, Energy Summit, Future of Work Summit, Growth Summit, Health Summit, Marketing Summit, MoneyConf, New Media Summit, Policy Summit, SaaS Summit, Sport Summit and Venture Summit. The schedule also filters by Masterclasses, Investor Masterclass, Startup Masterclass, Meetup, Night Summit, Press conference and Women in tech

stages.value: Centre Stage (MEO Arena) and Stages 2-14 (for example Stage 8 = Cybersecurity Summit and MoneyConf, Stage 10 = Developer Summit and Energy, Stage 11 = Policy Summit, Stage 13 = AI Summit), Masterclass 1-5, Meetup 1-6, Developer Lounge, Community Space, Pavilion 5 (Night Summit)

schedule_status.value: Live and still being added to ('We're adding more every week'). 823 sessions were published when read on 2026-11-01: 20 on 9 Nov, 280 on 10 Nov, 303 on 11 Nov and 220 on 12 Nov

tickets.value: General attendee: the page shows €1,595 and €1,297 excl. sales tax (probably the full price and the current offer). VIP: €1,950 and €1,585. Chairperson: €24,950 and €20,285. Investor: €0 (by application). Platinum Investor: €1,950. The registration FAQ prices a replacement ticket at €1,595

app.value: The Web Summit app (App Store and Google Play) holds your ticket QR code (needed to register), profile, chat, personal schedule, meetings, venue map, perks and jobs, and connection export

night_summit.value: This year Night Summit is on the show floor, in Pavilion 5 (FIL): Mon 9 Nov 20:00-23:00, Tue 10 Nov 18:00-21:00, Wed 11 Nov 18:00-21:00. Speed networking from 18:00, 100+ meetups, games. Accredited attendees only. Last entry 21:30, and after 17:00 the way in is the North Entrance near Moscavide metro

women_in_tech.value: Women in Tech tickets are sold out. Web Summit says 40% of startups at the 2025 edition were women-founded. The 7th annual Gender in Tech report was published on 27 Oct 2026

startup_programme.value: The 2026 startup programme is sold out (applications for 2027 are open). Accepted startups get 3 tickets, investor meetings (15-minute pre-scheduled slots), and can apply for PITCH (105 contenders), Startup Showcase and Mentor Hours (45-minute group sessions). The ALPHA, BETA and GROWTH package names do not appear on the 2026 pages read; the schedule has a 'GROWTH Lounge' location

investor_programme.value: Investor ticket (free, by application): startup discovery tools, investor meeting area, Investor Masterclasses. Platinum Investor €1,950: adds invite-only side events, the Investor Lounge and fast track. 'Venture' is the investor gathering. There is also a Limited Partner (LP) offering

developer_programme.value: Free tickets for active open-source contributors, chosen by an AI review of applicants. The 2026 programme is sold out. There is a Web Summit Hackathon in the Developer Lounge: pre-hackathon meetup 10 Nov 12:30, hackathon 11 Nov, winners announced 12 Nov 13:45

press.value: Media accreditation by application at /media/. Web Summit lists media attendees including CNBC, Bloomberg Media, NPR, The Atlantic, WSJ, NYT, Reuters and The Guardian. Press releases, photos and videos are linked from the media page. The press-release list itself sits in a Google Sheet that is not public

badge_pickup.value: Collect your lanyard and wristband at Humberto Delgado Airport Terminal 1 (Sat 7 Nov 09:30-22:00; Sun 8 and Mon 9 Nov 07:30-22:00; Tue 10 Nov 07:30-15:00) or at Pavilhão de Portugal, Alameda dos Oceanos (Sat 7 and Sun 8 Nov 12:00-18:00; Mon 9 Nov 12:00-22:00; Tue 10 and Wed 11 Nov 07:30-17:00; Thu 12 Nov 07:30-16:45). Bring your ticket QR (in the app) and photo ID. Replacing one lost item costs €100. Times are subject to change

getting_there.value: Oriente metro station (red line) is about 300 m from MEO Arena and 600 m from Pavilhão de Portugal. From Baixa-Chiado, take the green line to Alameda and then the red line, or the blue line to São Sebastião and then the red line. Carris buses 705, 725, 728, 750, 759 and 794 stop at Gare do Oriente. There are taxi and ride-share drop-off points. Hotels are booked through the partner b-network. November weather is 12-18°C with rain possible, and many areas are outdoors

opening_hours.value: No overall venue opening hours are published. Known times: registration hours (above), sessions from about 10:00, Night Summit hours (above). Event-level listings give 09:00-18:30 (Algarve Evolution's listing; not official)

wifi.value: Official event wifi is free throughout MEO Arena. For exhibitors (Startup Success team's email, 5 November 2026): hotspots and network tethering are strictly prohibited because they interfere with the event wifi, so plan demos to work offline

lisbon_funding_context.value: On 23 Sep 2026 Lisbon City Council approved €8M for Web Summit (more may follow), and is studying keeping the event until 2038

gaps: No Web Summit 2026 attendance figure is audited or final. '70,000+' is Web Summit's own claim, and the official 2026 numbers usually come out during the event (the 2025 numbers came out on 13 Nov 2025).

The schedule is still growing ('adding more every week'). 823 sessions were published on 2026-11-01 (first count). Re-checked later on 2026-11-01 on the public date page https://websummit.com/schedule/date/2026-11-09/: the Opening Night (9 Nov 18:00, Centre Stage) is still listed as 'Coming soon...' with no speakers. No session for the press-confirmed Apple speaker (Sébastien Gros) appears in the Centre Stage track (39 sessions, https://websummit.com/schedule/), so re-check.

No session title or description mentions the EU AI Act, NIS2 or DORA explicitly (re-checked on 2026-11-01 across the Cybersecurity, AI, Developer, Policy, SaaS, Corporate Innovation and Centre Stage tracks, the masterclasses and the meetups: 535 sessions). The regulation content found is Henna Virkkunen (EC), the DPC 'Regulating big tech', the DSA and Chat Control debates on the Policy Summit, a European Commission DG Connect masterclass that offers 'regulatory guidance' (ws26-s75), and a Deque masterclass on the European Accessibility Act (ws26-s55).
Some session speakers are listed with no organisation (the Developer Lounge sessions and several masterclasses). They are left null as listed.

The ALPHA, BETA and GROWTH startup package names were not found on the 2026 Web Summit pages read. Road 2 Web Summit (Startup Portugal) offers a discount on packages, according to a search snippet, but this is unconfirmed on the page.
No overall venue opening hours are published. Only registration and Night Summit hours are official.

Lisbon side events: there is no single public list. Web Summit lists off-site side events in its own schedule (13 found on 2026-11-01, all now in the feed). Portugal Tech Week (6-15 Nov) lists its events at https://portugaltechweek.com/events/; on 2026-11-01 only its home page and five Lisbon events were read, so its list is still incomplete. Altss lists zero side events. Luma and Eventbrite were not searched directly. No new Algarve events before the summit were listed by Algarve Evolution on 2026-11-01.
No dates or venues are published for our own Algarve meetups before the summit (newsroom, 31 Oct).
The Helical Fusion press release date (30 Oct) comes from search results; einnews.com blocked us.
The Web Summit press-release list (a Google Sheet) is not public, so press releases are not in the feed.
Some third-party pages (Lusa, Latvian LIAA, ECO) give other date ranges (8-12 Nov, 6-12 Nov). These are delegation or press windows; the official dates are 9-12 Nov.
